meta.purpose: The machine BRAIN the forecast/coach agents load as context and apply. Human-readable view lives in ../NG_BEHAVIOR_KNOWLEDGE.md. Each pass MERGES (refine confidence + add plays); nothing is overwritten blindly.
meta.guard: GENERAL rules with mechanism + n only - never memorized specific days. Skill is judged on days NEVER touched in any pass (true holdout) + forward-live, not on the training year. A coach that curve-fits noise loses money adaptively; a coach matching the live moment to general patterns adapts correctly.
meta.regime_scope: 12 warm-season days (Jul-Sep 2025), contango-flat. Winter/backwardation + Mondays NOT yet in-sample.
meta.risk_gate: Every play is provisional-until-live: must clear the size-vs-fee wall and paper-trade on Kalshi demo before real orders. The coach adapts WITHIN bounded risk caps.
meta.s92.2_note: Added timing.subsecond_reversal_exhaustion (the coin/BTC sub-second look-ahead tested on NG, S90) as an execution-layer turn-timing HYPOTHESIS + native-tick frontier. No Group-2 lesson merge yet (pending scorecard).

plays.trigger: a leg is forming (order-flow window ~300s around the trigger push)
plays.call: NG's side = sign(dip_imb_level) when strong (|dip_imb_level| >= 0.15); fire on the LAGGING Kalshi mark on that side
plays.caveats: NOWCAST (flow overlaps the nascent leg), not a from-flat forecast. Direction only - correctly-signed legs still round-trip (size separately). Warm-season.

plays.trigger: at entry, when flow (dip_imb_level) is flat/ambiguous
plays.call: fade the heavy resting side - ask-heavy book -> price runs UP through it (wall = fuel, not floor)
plays.caveats: Weaker than flow; use only as a tie-breaker when flow is flat.

plays.trigger: a leg's favorable peak crosses a $ threshold in real time
plays.call: RIDE - continuation rises with size: $50->0.43, $150->0.57, $250->0.75, $350->0.92, $500->1.00. The ~$350 crossing is a 92% 'stay in' event; $500 was 11/11.
plays.caveats: peak_usd is realized-so-far; the CROSSING is the usable real-time event, not the final peak.

plays.trigger: a big leg maturing - watch the far-side book as price runs
plays.read: turn_far_thinning (far-ladder change entry->now) + turn_aligned_push (book support at the level)
plays.call: STAY while the far side is being RECRUITED (new resting liquidity steps in ahead, turn_far_thinning negative = ladder growing). EXIT when it flips to eaten/stalled (turn_far_thinning >0) AND support collapses (turn_exhaustion deep) - both firing = a genuine reversal top.
plays.caveats: Reframed from n=3 'fuel spent' to n=101 RECRUITMENT. Measured entry->peak (diagnostic); the LIVE running turn-track (far_thinning crossing neg->pos as the run matures) is the next build - not yet validated as a live exit.

plays.trigger: how the leg is being built
plays.call: a slow GRIND holds (ride); a front-loaded SPIKE round-trips (scalp/skip). Of legs that held, ~1/111 spiked fast.
plays.caveats: Shape is partly realized-as-it-goes; usable once the first ~60s of build is seen.

plays.trigger: at the open, from the week's EIA storage surprise
plays.call: big |surprise| (>=~20) -> expect a TREND day (bigger legs); near-consensus -> range/chop day. SIGN does NOT sort direction.
plays.caveats: Did NOT reproduce on continuation-rate in the multi-target pass; season-confounded, ~6 prints. A weak day-level prior only.

plays.trigger: at the open, from the weekday
plays.call: Wed = US-session up-lean; Thu = storage catalyst AT the 10:30 ET print; Fri = range, OVERRIDES surprise; Tue = strongest-trend weekday; Mon = distinct (weekend gap), NOT yet characterized.
plays.caveats: Never pool across DOW. Mon = OPEN (re-downloading). Warm-season only.

plays.trigger: at a maturing leg's turn - the crypto/coin (BTC) fine-resolution price-reversal + dipole-EXHAUSTION edge (S36/S37), tested on NG NYMEX futures DIRECTLY (S90), not Kalshi
plays.read: dipole EXHAUSTION (order-flow imbalance COLLAPSING toward 0.5 = leader weakening) stacked with fine-resolution price-reversal timing (odcore/info_dipole.py, gated-swing stack)
plays.call: EXECUTION-LAYER turn-timing ONLY (never a from-flat open forecast). Near a turn the exhaustion-collapse marks the real reversal and fine price-reversal pins entry ~5-6bps off the turn (vs ~9-11 at 1-min). Use for turn/exit timing on the futures tape and to fire on the lagging Kalshi mark. The coins showed this edge; NG carries a faint right-signed version of it.

evidence.detail: oppose+exhaust 0.410 vs trend+strengthen 0.382 = +2.7pp (BTC-direction); EXHAUSTION does the work - static divergence did NOT transfer (opposite sign)
evidence.crypto_source: S36/S37: 1-sec timing enters ~5-6bps off the true turn vs ~9-11bps at 1-min

plays.caveats: SMALL BUT REAL and RIGHT-SIGNED - the coins' edge carries a faint pulse onto NG. LOAD-BEARING (Greg S90): the 1-sec canary is FAR too coarse; the real edge lives at NATIVE TICK / ms-us (our MBP-10 tape is nanosecond ts_event/ts_recv). 1-sec binning threw away the resolution the edge lives at. Real test pending at native tick, per-cell (tod x regime x vol), event-time; fees secondary (HFT/latency audience). EXECUTION-layer - do NOT use as a blind open-time curve input.

mechanisms.text: Weekly EIA storage print Thu 10:30 ET is the one scheduled catalyst; busiest Thursday hour.
US session ~08-16 ET decides the day's range; overnight is thin drift. STABLE.
Weekend info accumulates -> Monday reprices at the Sun-eve reopen -> distinct shape. OPEN.
Summer=cooling/weather-led; winter=heating, bigger swings, withdrawal. Winter UNKNOWN until full year.
LNG feedgas / production / pipeline outages are real drivers, currently NO feed. Data gap.
